nodes.label: Document
nodes.name: SOC2 Evidence Tracker
nodes.text: The SOC2 readiness program tracks access reviews, incident response evidence, vendor reviews and security-control owners. Aisha Raman coordinates the audit. Kavya Shah owns IAM evidence. The team uses Jira for evidence tasks and Confluence for control documentation.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.name: Audit Readiness Runbook
nodes.text: For the SOC2 audit, control owners submit evidence through Jira. Security evidence is reviewed by Kavya Shah and compliance sign-off is coordinated by Aisha Raman. AWS IAM reports and Datadog incident records are commonly attached.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.name: Customer 360 Architecture Notes
nodes.text: Customer 360 uses Snowflake as the analytical data platform. Rohan Mehta owns the data pipelines and uses Python, SQL and Airflow. Nikhil Rao designed the AWS integration and API boundaries.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.name: Pricing Strategy Memo
nodes.text: The pricing revamp considered usage-based, seat-based and hybrid packaging. Meera Iyer led product analysis, Daniel Wong modeled revenue scenarios, and Sara Thomas reviewed contractual implications.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.name: Pricing Decision Log
nodes.text: The approved 2026 pricing model uses a hybrid base subscription plus usage component for enterprise customers. The decision was approved by Daniel Wong and Meera Iyer after finance modeling and customer research.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.name: AI Support Copilot Design
nodes.text: The support copilot uses retrieval-augmented generation. Arjun Nair owns the retrieval pipeline, Pinecone stores embeddings, and Confluence is used as a source of internal product documentation.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.name: Cloud Cost Review
nodes.text: The cost optimization program targets AWS spend. Nikhil Rao owns infrastructure changes, Daniel Wong validates savings forecasts, and Datadog is used to monitor workload utilization.

nodes.label: Document
nodes.name: Vendor Risk Assessment
nodes.text: Security and compliance reviewed a critical analytics vendor. Aisha Raman coordinated the review, Kavya Shah assessed security controls, and Sara Thomas reviewed data-processing contractual terms.

nodes.label: Decision
nodes.name: Adopt hybrid enterprise pricing
nodes.summary: Use a base subscription plus usage component for enterprise customers.

nodes.label: Decision
nodes.name: Use Snowflake as Customer 360 warehouse
nodes.summary: Standardize analytical storage for Customer 360 on Snowflake.

nodes.label: Decision
nodes.name: Use Pinecone for support copilot retrieval
nodes.summary: Use Pinecone for vector retrieval in the AI Support Copilot.

nodes.label: Decision
nodes.name: Centralize SOC2 evidence tracking in Jira
nodes.summary: Use Jira as the operational tracker for SOC2 evidence tasks.

nodes.label: Decision
nodes.name: Introduce AWS rightsizing policy
nodes.summary: Apply automated rightsizing recommendations to eligible AWS workloads.
